name: Red Silk Bandanas
summary: Scout Riell sends the People's Militia after Red Silk Bandanas in the Deadmines. Their fine weave marks the Defias leaders who direct the uprising in Westfall.

sections.title: A Hierarchy in Cloth
sections.body: Scout Riell and the People's Militia have learned that cloth marks rank in the Defias Brotherhood. Common cutpurses and highwaymen across Westfall tie coarse red cloth over their faces. Senior conspirators and inner-circle operatives wear fine red silk. Bringing back their bandanas strikes at the experienced officers coordinating Edwin VanCleef's uprising.

sections.title: Striking the Core
sections.body: The senior outlaws gather deep in the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook. Sentinels and scouts outside Sentinel Hill depend on freelance champions to enter the contested tunnels. Each silk bandana recovered means one fewer lieutenant organizing ambushes, guarding weapon caches, or enforcing VanCleef's rule across Westfall.

faq.q: Why do the Defias wear red bandanas?
faq.answer: The Defias wear red bandanas to hide their faces and show allegiance to Edwin VanCleef's rebellion. The red cloth marks their Brotherhood across Stormwind's territories.

faq.q: What makes the red silk bandanas special compared to regular bandanas?
faq.answer: Scout Riell says the fabric marks rank in the Brotherhood. Common street thugs wear coarse, cheap cloth, while veterans, officers, and trusted lieutenants wear red silk.

aliases: who gives red silk bandanas quest
faq.answer: Scout Riell serves the People's Militia in Westfall. The operative tracks Defias movements and directs adventurers against their strongholds around the Deadmines.

faq.q: Where are the Defias wearing silk bandanas located?
faq.answer: Defias wearing silk bandanas gather in and around the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook. Edwin VanCleef's senior forces oversee underground operations there.
The People's Militia is a volunteer defense force formed by Gryan Stoutmantle and Westfall's embattled farmers. They protect their lands after the Stormwind army failed to provide enough garrisons.

faq.q: Do these bandanas have any use outside of proving a kill?
aliases: can you wear red silk bandana
faq.answer: For the People's Militia, the bandanas prove that high-ranking outlaws have been eliminated. Each one weakens the Brotherhood's command structure.

angles.text: As an ally of the Alliance, every officer felled in the Deadmines loosens the Brotherhood's hold on Stormwind's breadbasket.
As a rogue, you know red silk marks veteran cutthroats and covert conspirators in the Defias tradition of underworld tradecraft.
As a tailor, you know fine red silk costs too much for common bandits. Its use shows how lavishly equipped and funded the Brotherhood's leadership is.
